text: GTA 6 global marketing ramped up: - Giant poster installed on a French skyscraper, with a second one in progress. - Planes flying over Miami Beach displaying Trailer 1 and “Welcome to Vice City” banners. - Vice City Blimp landed in Florida; marketing use TBD. - “Welcome to Vice City” signage at Miami International Airport. - Rockstar offering free tickets to BAYO’s Little Haiti show via partnership with Michaël Brun. - Boucher Brothers installing custom GTA 6 beachfront furniture. - New Wynwood murals from the game displayed at Wynwood Walls until January 1st, 2027, plus new merch and free admission for Miami residents through 2028. - Two new screenshots and a Bloomberg cover story released. @RockstarGames 😠

Take-Two has officially scheduled the next earnings call for Monday, November 9th, just 10 days before GTA 6 launches. Expecting the launch trailer (final one) to drop in the same week. @RockstarGames 😠
A new promotional message from PlayStation, which is essentially a reminder to do one last drive in GTA 5: @RockstarGames 😠
A fan spotted the Vice City blimp flying over North Carolina, as it heads to Florida for the GTA 6 marketing. @RockstarGames 😠
90% complete until GTA 6 officially releases. 37 days remaining ⏳ @RockstarGames 😠
